_note: Controlled vocabulary for the process specification campaign. Every enumerated value a platform may use is listed here. validate_spec.py rejects anything not in this file. Adding a value is a deliberate act - raise it as a gap, do not invent it in a submission.

data_objects._source: IEC 61968-11:2013 CIM Work package. NOTE there is no WorkOrder class - use Work plus the workOrderNumber attribute.

trigger_kinds._source: BPMN 2.0 start event types plus none

source_statuses.verified: Read verbatim from official or issuing-body text.
source_statuses.regulation: Verbatim from current eCFR or equivalent primary regulatory text.
source_statuses.clause-verified: Clause number and title confirmed; body paywalled and NOT read. Cite by reference; never paraphrase the content.
source_statuses.consensus: Published guidance from a recognised industry body. Not law.

en17007_processes._source: EN 17007:2017. Level-1 names from Table 1; clause numbers from the contents; level-2 process names read from clause 6 of the supplied text, 2026-08-29. CORRECTED 2026-08-29: MAN was recorded at 6.9 and is 6.2; DOC was recorded at 6.10 and is 6.9 - 6.10 is DTA. Both errors had reached shipped citations because the validator checked clause numbers for level-2 processes only.
en17007_processes._naming: The contents heads clause 6.12 'MRG process' while Table 1 gives 'MRQ'. MRQ is used throughout this repository.
en17007_processes._scope_note: Level-2 processes are narrower than their titles suggest. COR.1 is scoped to CORRECTIVE maintenance and its purpose already includes ranking and a first schedule, so it overlaps ACT.1. COR.2 is fault diagnosis, not asset identification. PRV.1 is failure-mode characterisation; cycles come from PRV.2. MRQ.4 and MRQ.6 read 'contribute to' and 'participate in' - MRQ is maintenance's INPUT to someone else's design process, not the production of a design.
en17007_processes._gap: TOL.1 is not machine-readable in the supplied text and is recorded as absent rather than guessed. EN 17007 has NO funding, approval or authorisation process: the only occurrences of 'approval' and 'authorized' in clause 6 are SER.4 service acceptance and DOC.5 document update rights. MAN.4 'Prepare and negotiate the budgets' is the closest, and it is budget setting, not work authorisation.

ACT: Implement preventive and/or corrective actions on the item

MRQ: Deliver maintenance requirements during items design and modification
TOL: Deliver the tools, support equipment and information system

decision_variables._note: Shared variable names for DMN. A decision reused across categories MUST use these exact names or the two copies drift and become uncallable. 1.3.4 routing and 16.2.1 sourcing are the same determination - this is how they stay one rule set. lowerCamelCase, no underscores.
decision_variables.maintenanceType: EN 13306 cl. 7: preventive.predetermined | preventive.conditionBased | corrective.immediate | corrective.deferred | unclassified
decision_variables.originationRoute: customerRequest | deviceCondition | inspectionFinding | networkEvent | fieldIdentified | regulatoryProgramme | plannedCycle
decision_variables.hazardGrade: GPTC G-192-11: grade1 | grade2 | grade3 | none
decision_variables.populationAttribute: businessDistrict | serviceLine | cathodicallyUnprotected | offshore | programmePopulation | null
decision_variables.priorFinding: The outcome of the previous compliance activity, or null
decision_variables.deliveryRoute: internal | externalService | qualifiedCrewPool | districtFieldOperations | meteringOperations | workManagementReview

id_convention._note: IDs in generated XML are DERIVED, never hand-chosen, so three platforms cannot diverge. The generator applies these; platforms never write IDs.
id_convention.process: P_<category>_<group>  e.g. P_1_1  for BPMN process of group 1.1
id_convention.decision: d_<dotted id with dots as underscores>  e.g. d_1_3_1

expression_language.reference: FEEL. The published reference files are OMG-conformant and use FEEL.
expression_language.flowable: JUEL. Flowable has no FEEL implementation and meets no DMN conformance level. The Flowable binding is generated separately by build_flowable_binding.py and is NEVER merged into the reference.
expression_language.rule: Never write a vendor expression into a reference file.

banned_terms._note: Product, client and vendor names. validate_spec.py rejects a submission containing any of these. Observed client material goes to eam/specializations/, where this check does not apply.

banned_language._note: House style. Rejected in intent, activities, controls and measures text.

content_budget._note: Content is budgeted so one fixed slide layout absorbs every category without shrinking type or repaginating. Ranges are set from measured category 1.0 with headroom. A breach is an error, not a warning: it is the thing that makes two decks look different even though one generator built them.
content_budget._derivation: category 1.0, 18 processes: p90 and max measured 2026-08-28

block_total._note: The two bottom blocks share a fixed band. These caps keep the band filled without spilling past the footer.

source_status_ceiling._why: A citation status is a claim about what somebody actually read. The status vocabulary alone cannot enforce that, and it did not: on 2026-08-29 all three specification files carried 'verified' against standards nobody in this project holds - 24 in category 1.0, 18 in category 2.0 and 31 in the category 3.0 submission. Claude introduced the pattern and the other platforms inherited it from the pack. This table is the mechanical fix: a source may never be cited above its ceiling, and validate_spec.py enforces it.
source_status_ceiling._raising: A ceiling is raised only by obtaining the text. Put the document in Tim Evidence/, record it in the artifact registry with its sha256, and change the entry here in the same commit.
source_status_ceiling._default: clause-verified - anything not listed is paywalled until shown otherwise.

held_in_full._note: Read end to end, or freely available in full. 'verified' is permitted.

public_law._note: Public primary sources. 'regulation' is permitted and is the right status.

member_gated._note: Industry-body material behind membership. 'consensus' is the ceiling - it is not law and it was not read from an official copy.

paywalled._note: Clause number and title can be confirmed from public contents pages; the body cannot. 'clause-verified' is the ceiling and it FORBIDS paraphrasing content that was not read.
